name: Woman's Silk Robe
material: Silk: satin weave with supplementary weft pattern
summary: This rare private, rather than court, surcoat displays flowers of all seasons arranged with elegant simplicity. Included among the 25 symbolic flowers are peonies, plum blossoms, magnolias, and chrysanthemums.
